'''George Gundry''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II]] on 6 May 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Snowtrooper Odds]], according to Jonny Chu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d698">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapocon-ii-part-deux-5-6-2000d698/ ramapocon-ii-part-deux-5-6-2000], DeckTech (Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapocon-ii-part-deux-5-6-2000d698/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
